title: Tag Vandal Font
author: BILLI
description:
**Tag Vandal – Urban Graffiti Display Font**
Bring raw street energy and rebellious attitude to your designs with **Tag Vandal**, a bold graffiti-inspired display font featuring sharp angles, edgy letterforms, and an unmistakable urban aesthetic.
Designed for creatives who want to make a powerful visual statement, Tag Vandal delivers a striking look that stands out in streetwear branding, skateboard graphics, music artwork, promotional posters, and contemporary urban design projects.
Its aggressive character and distinctive style make it a strong choice for projects that demand bold typography, underground culture, and an expressive street-inspired identity.
**Perfect For**
– Streetwear and clothing brand designs
– Graffiti-inspired artwork and urban graphics
– Skateboard and extreme sports designs
– Hip-hop, punk, and alternative music artwork
– Album covers and mixtape graphics
– Event flyers and promotional posters
– T-shirt prints and merchandise
– Logo concepts and bold brand identities
– Stickers, packaging, and editorial headlines
**Font Features**
– Bold, angular, graffiti-inspired letterforms
– Distinctive urban and rebellious visual style
– High-impact display typography
– Suitable for headlines, titles, and statement graphics
– Ideal for street culture, alternative branding, and creative merchandise
**Product Details**
– Font Name: Tag Vandal
– Font Style: Urban Graffiti Display
– File Format: OTF (OpenType Font)
– Compatibility: Windows
